mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at 33 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School.

The City of Verona has announced that the Zoning and Sign Ordinance has been updated, and residents can now use an interactive map to find their specific zoning district. Additionally, the city has confirmed four polling locations are ready for residents, and you are encouraged to check the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm your designated place before heading out to vote.

Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on October 19, followed by various trivia nights starting October 20.

Last Thursday, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers developed probable cause after investigating reports of dangerous driving, though no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich Chocolate Volcano. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so make sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
